system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: This log is included in the prompt for subsequent invocations of the planning agent
system_prompt_style.note: Hands-on VeruSAGE; prompt includes evolving history, static-analysis-filtered actions and focused code context.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: VeruSAGE performs a static analysis of the codebase before invoking the planning agent to identify available resources such as lemmas, recursive functions, and opaque functions.
env_context_strategy.note: Hands-on injects focused code context plus static analysis; closest value is 'mixed' but no tool navigation in hands-on (hands-off relies on CLI agent navigation of vstd).

context_compaction.evidence_quote: we provide a focused view containing only the relevant code surrounding the failure and the specific error message

observation_format.evidence_quote: Each step starts with Verus reporting verification errors, if any, of the Rust program with the most up-to-date proof candidate

tool_call_format.note: Only paper available; action agents output search-and-replace blocks but parsing mechanism not described.

tool_count.note: No tool registry in evidence; hands-on uses action agents rather than tools.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: we instruct action agents to output proof candidates as concise code diffs (specifically, search-and-replace blocks) rather than rewriting entire files

protocol_standardization.note: Paper-only; no dependency list or source to grep.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Each step starts with Verus reporting verification errors, if any, of the Rust program with the most up-to-date proof candidate; the candidate selector then decides whether to take this proof candidate or revert to an earlier one
loop_primitives.note: Two-phase plan-then-act per step with Verus verification loop.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the planning agent examines the errors and the context history to select an action agent
planning_granularity.note: Planning selects the next action each step; no persisted plan object described.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: the planning agent examines the errors and the context history to select an action agent, which then proposes an updated proof candidate
multi_agent_topology.note: 'Agents' are specialised prompts dispatched by a planning agent.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: VeruSAGE has a dedicated planning agent that is equipped with the high-level description of every action agent

human_in_loop.note: No run loop code available; paper describes automated runs only.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: VeruSAGE maintains a log of past proof attempts, recording what action agent was used, what is the synthesized code diff, and what is the outcome

self_verification.evidence_quote: Each step starts with Verus reporting verification errors
self_verification.note: Verus verifier plus static-analysis cheat checker.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The accumulated success rate goes from 41% after the first run to 56% at three runs.
retry_policy.note: Multiple runs were an experiment, not a harness feature; paper-only.

rollback.evidence_quote: the candidate selector then decides whether to take this proof candidate or revert to an earlier one

termination_condition.evidence_quote: VeruSAGE terminates only when (1) the code is successfully verified by Verus, (2) the total execution time exceeds 20 minutes, or (3) 20 proof steps have been conducted.

timeouts.evidence_quote: the total execution time exceeds 20 minutes

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: we run all experiments in containers

tracing.evidence_quote: Each run of a CLI agent produces two files: its standard output log and the verified file.

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: The benchmark and code implementation of VeruSAGE are released at microsoft/verus-proof-synthesis

guardrails.evidence_quote: the static-analysis based cheat checker in VeruSAGE can produce false positives, causing correct or promising proof to be rejected

target_domain.evidence_quote: VeruSAGE: A Study of Agent-Based Verification for Rust Systems

open_source.note: Release stated but licence file not in evidence.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: VeruSAGE uses Azure OpenAI APIs to access OpenAI and Claude models directly.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We implemented VeruSAGE by adding about 15,600 lines of Python code into AutoVerus
